title: Chicken Mince San Choy Bow
description: Fast pan-fried chicken mince in lettuce cups. The Thermomix chops the aromatics, but the mince needs the pan so it browns rather than steams.

items.note: Or a small tin of water chestnuts, chopped

items.item: rice wine vinegar or lime juice

steps.text: Mince the garlic ({{garlic}} cloves), ginger ({{ginger}}) and the white parts of the spring onion. In the Thermomix, 3 sec / Speed 5 does this in one go. Dice the carrot by hand so it stays chunky rather than turning to pulp.
Stir the oyster sauce ({{oyster}}), soy ({{soy}}), sesame oil ({{sesame-oil}}) and vinegar ({{vinegar}}) together in a small bowl. No added salt, the oyster and soy carry plenty.

Heat the oil ({{oil}}) in the cast iron over high heat until shimmering. Add the mince ({{mince}}) and press it flat. Leave it alone for 3 minutes to build a crust, then break it up and cook until no pink remains and the liquid has gone.
Push the mince aside, add the garlic, ginger and spring onion whites to the bare pan for 30 seconds until fragrant, then stir through with the carrot.
Pour in the sauce and toss 1–2 minutes until it coats the mince and looks glossy rather than wet. Taste and adjust with a splash more vinegar or soy.
Spoon into the lettuce cups. Finish with the spring onion greens, coriander and chilli.

notes.title: Restored
notes.text: This card was in the August build and dropped out of later rebuilds. Restored unchanged from the August version.

notes.title: Neutral oil
notes.text: Rice bran is the default here. High smoke point, no flavour of its own. Extra virgin olive oil and sesame oil both burn at this heat.

notes.title: Lettuce
notes.text: Iceberg holds its shape best. Trim the cups with scissors so they sit flat.
